clips.title: The story
paras: At the Valley of Trials, Gornek gives new troll warriors a message to take to Frang.

Gornek gives new troll warriors a message from Tar'sere, addressed to Frang, the warrior trainer near the Den. It introduces the recruit to combat training in Durotar and asks them to present themselves to Frang. The message calls on them to take up weapons for the Horde.
